indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.noAnalysis: No analysis yet — trigger a run from the Scores page or wait for the nightly pipeline.

info.sma_cross: Compares the 50-day and 200-day simple moving averages. When the shorter average is above the longer one (a "golden cross"), it signals an uptrend; when below (a "death cross"), it signals a downtrend.
info.ema20: Compares the price to its 20-day exponential moving average. Trading above the EMA suggests short-term upward momentum; trading below suggests downward momentum.
info.macd: MACD tracks the gap between a fast and a slow moving average. A positive histogram (MACD above its signal line) suggests bullish momentum; a negative histogram suggests bearish momentum.
info.rsi: The Relative Strength Index (0-100) measures the speed of recent price moves. Readings below 30 suggest the stock is oversold (a potential bounce); above 70 suggest it's overbought (a potential pullback).
info.stochastic: Stochastic %K compares the closing price to its recent high-low range (0-100). Below 20 suggests oversold conditions; above 80 suggests overbought conditions.
info.bollinger: Bollinger %B shows where the price sits within its volatility bands. Near 0 means the price is at the lower band (a potential bounce); near 1 means it's at the upper band (a potential pullback).
info.atr: Average True Range measures volatility in price units. A sharp rise above its recent average flags higher risk and can precede larger swings in either direction.
info.obv: On-Balance Volume adds or subtracts each day's volume based on price direction, tracking whether buying or selling pressure is accumulating.
info.vwap_distance: Measures how far the price is from its 20-day volume-weighted average price (VWAP). Trading above VWAP suggests buyers are in control; trading below suggests sellers are.
info.adx: The Average Directional Index (0-100) measures trend strength regardless of direction. Readings above 20, combined with +DI/-DI, indicate a strong directional trend (up or down).
info.williams_r: Williams %R (-100 to 0) measures how close the price is to its recent high-low range. Below -80 suggests oversold conditions; above -20 suggests overbought conditions.
info.cci: The Commodity Channel Index measures how far the price has deviated from its statistical average. Readings below -100 suggest oversold conditions; above +100 suggest overbought conditions.
info.trend_channel: Fits a linear price channel over recent history. Price near the lower band of an uptrend (or the upper band of a downtrend) can signal a reversal opportunity in the channel's direction.
info.support_resistance: Identifies price levels where the stock has repeatedly reversed. Trading near a strong support level is a bullish signal; trading near a strong resistance level is a bearish signal.
